---
title: Code block style, fill on the native path
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    syntax-highlighting: idiomatic
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template sets `fill` in `quarto-code-block-style`.
Both native code blocks must use that fill instead of the default `luma(230)` set rule.
The probe counts the blocks that Typst draws with the fill, and the compile fails when the count is wrong.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update(s => s + (fill: rgb("#fafafa")))
#show block.where(fill: rgb("#fafafa")): it => { counter("cbs-fill").step(); it }
#show block.where(fill: luma(230)): it => { counter("cbs-default").step(); it }
```

```python
x = 1
```

```r
y <- 2
```

```{=typst}
#context {
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-fill").final().first(), 2, message: "expected 2 code blocks with the fill from quarto-code-block-style")
  assert.eq(counter("cbs-default").final().first(), 0, message: "a block inside a code block kept the native default fill")
}
```
